The active integrated v2 derives context by unique source replacement, preserves all other prompt characters and shares it across proposal/direct/blind/leaky. The blind condition excludes candidate values introduced from the answer, not values already present in source/context.
facts.does_not_imply: A clean question, semantically correct frame, factuality oracle, original-generator causal explanation or new AUROC
